findings.summary: The 30K search QPS figure does not follow from the stated ~100 browse sessions per order and the 500/s peak.
findings.evidence: "~100 browse sessions per order gives ~==30K search/menu QPS== at peak" (500 orders/s × 100 = 50K QPS; the 58/s average × 100 ≈ 5.8K)
findings.fix: Make the inputs match the output. Either say ~60 sessions per order at the 500/s peak (≈30K QPS), or keep 100 sessions and change the figure to ~50K QPS on this page, the cover, the search page, the scaling table and the takeaway.
